selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: How is Allah’s power described at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as pure, exalted, radiant, and eternal, above all other lights.

questions.question: How does the passage describe all things from the smallest to the largest?
questions.answer: It describes them as obedient to Allah’s command and under His power.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about difference in scale before Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Differences in scale do not create differences in difficulty for Him.

questions.question: What main idea is shown by saying that large and small, many and few, particular and universal are all the same for that power?
questions.answer: It shows that Allah’s power is unrestricted and works equally easily on every level of creation.

questions.question: What is learned from the example of the commander and the army?
questions.answer: A single command can effectively direct one or many.

questions.question: What two divine qualities are directly linked to order and equilibrium?
questions.answer: Divine justice and endless wisdom.

questions.question: How does the passage compare moving stars with moving atoms?
questions.answer: It says both are equally easy for Allah through the wisdom and order of His power.

questions.question: What role does spring play in the reasoning of the passage?
questions.answer: It serves as visible proof that mass revival and renewal happen regularly by Allah’s command.

questions.question: What does the mention of “hundreds of thousands” add to the description of spring?
questions.answer: It stresses the enormous variety and number of living forms revived at that time.

questions.question: What central claim does the passage make about Allah’s power and the creation of many things?
questions.answer: It claims that creating endless things together is as easy for Allah as creating a single thing.

questions.question: How are the realities of created things described so that the reader can understand their relation to divine power?
questions.answer: They are described as bright and mirror-like, able to receive and display what Allah wills.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage draw from that obedience?
questions.answer: It concludes that creating countless things side by side is entirely easy for Allah.

questions.question: In the example of the huge ship and the child’s toy, what is being compared?
questions.answer: The ease of moving something enormous is compared with the ease of moving something small when proper order is in place.

questions.question: What does the commander example show about the effect of a single command?
questions.answer: One command can send either one person or a whole army into action.

questions.question: In this passage, what is said to be the beginning and foundation of order in creation?
questions.answer: Divine justice and unending wisdom within Allah’s power.

questions.question: What seasonal example is used to make the idea of resurrection easier to understand?
questions.answer: The revival of life in spring is used as a clear example.

questions.question: How does the passage connect spring to the idea of resurrection?
questions.answer: Spring is shown as a repeated mass revival that points to the possibility and ease of resurrection.

questions.question: How does the passage help the reader understand resurrection?
questions.answer: It points to the yearly revival of life in spring as a smaller example of a greater rising.

questions.question: According to the passage, what relationship exists between Allah’s power and light?
questions.answer: Allah’s power is presented as the highest and purest form of light.

questions.question: Which kinds of created things are mentioned to show the wide range of Allah’s command?
questions.answer: The passage mentions everything from tiny particles, plants, and animals to stars, suns, and moons.

questions.question: What statement in the passage rejects the idea that Allah could be overwhelmed by many tasks?
questions.answer: The passage says that no task or concern interrupts another.

questions.question: What principle is illustrated by the image of a large ship moved as easily as a toy?
questions.answer: Ordered power can direct something huge with ease when it is fully under control.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the example of a commander sending either one soldier or a whole army with one order?
questions.answer: A single command can direct both a small number and a great number when those receiving the order are obedient.

questions.question: What divine qualities are named as the source of cosmic order?
questions.answer: Absolute justice and endless wisdom are named.
